description: Get the top-paying locations for a job family within one country, ranked by median (p50) yearly total compensation in USD from submissions in the last 2 years. Returns up to 10 locations with their median. Use it to compare where a role pays most inside a country. Its window differs from get-salary-percentiles (the last 12 months), so the same location can show a different median: quote get-salary-percentiles for one location's pay. Free limit: Median (p50) total compensation for the top locations in one country. No company or level filter. Pass canonical slugs (jobFamilySlug, locationSlug(s), countrySlug, companySlug(s)): resolve names first with search-job-families, search-locations and search-companies; never guess a slug. REQUIRED arguments: jobFamilySlug, countrySlug.

countrySlug.description: A COUNTRY location slug, e.g. "united-states", "india", "united-kingdom". Resolve it with search-locations first; cities, metros and states are rejected.

jobFamilySlug.description: A Levels.fyi job family slug, e.g. "software-engineer", "product-manager", "data-scientist".

name: get-location-stats
